description: The installer's refusal travels verbatim (S65, DB19): what was refused and why, from internal/skills' own sentence, never a summary — the operator fixes the FILE, so they must read the file's fault. Nothing landed and nothing moved: a refused install stages, validates and discards; the managed root keeps exactly what it held before. This is the code for overwrite-without-force, for a source whose SKILL.md breaks a spec rule, and for a remove aimed at the user root.

data.what: skills.install refused: a managed skill named "pdf" already exists at /home/dev/.local/share/aeon/skills/pdf — re-run with force to replace it
data.means: the skills install or remove refused the request
